headline: MPO Policy Board

meeting.summary: The board approved a full 2045 transportation plan update with work extended to mid-April and agreed with state road classification reports.
meeting.recap: The acting chair opened the meeting on November 25, 2024, at 8:02 a.m.[[0:00:42]] The board approved the minutes of its August 28, 2024 meeting.[[0:07:37]] The executive director said the current long-range transportation plan expires at the end of this year.[[0:14:07]] Without a valid plan, the board cannot amend its transportation improvement program, or TIP.[[0:16:18]] Contract money went to the TIP update, so too little is left for all the planned work.[[0:18:03]] The executive director proposed a full 2045 plan update instead of reaffirming the 2040 plan, with work extended to mid-April.[[0:20:12]] The final plan is meant to be adopted before April 15.[[0:27:33]] The board approved the proposed changes with eight ayes.[[0:35:14]] A presenter said a new federal urban boundary for roads would not affect USDA home loans.[[0:49:34]] The board agreed with state reports on urban boundaries and road classifications, with eight ayes.[[1:03:48]] Staff said county and state matching money was too small to claim the full federal share.[[1:20:11]] Staff will ask the county and state for larger shares in next year's budget.[[1:20:20]] The meeting adjourned at 9:26 a.m.[[1:24:44]]
decided: The board approved the August 28, 2024 minutes.
The board approved the executive director's proposed changes to the long-range transportation plan action plan.
The board voted to agree with the findings of the state's federal aid urban boundary and road classification reports.
meeting.next: Staff will poll board members on December availability to schedule the next meeting. Staff expect to bring work plan amendments to the board early next year. The state will post a final map of the road classifications on its website. The chair asked state staff to notify the executive director when the carbon reduction strategy is done, so it can go to members.
